title: Find and Replace: R&D Investment Following the Erosion of Existing Products
authors: Joshua Krieger; Xuelin Li; Richard T. Thakor
near_miss_reason: time-varying (lagged) firm controls in every main-text column ($controlvar / $controls); data not shipped (licensed Biomedtracker/Cortellis panel provided only to the Data Editor)
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: PHA = 1 in years t..t+3 after an FDA Public Health Advisory on one of the firm's approved drugs (earliest PHA per drug project), switching on at firm-specific years 2000-2016 with never-warned firms as controls, firm FE (areg absorb(firm_id)) and year FE; the firm-ICD panel uses firm and market-by-year FE (mktyear). Treatment switches off after t+3 (handled by dropping post-adoption untreated periods per protocol). However, every main-text regression includes time-varying controls: Tables 2-5 use $controlvar (L.avgchance L.indicationnumber log_ta L.capex_ta L.cash_ta L.div_ta L.ebit_ta L.ppe_ta L.rd_ta L.debt_ta), Table 3 adds $acq_yr_con, firm-ICD regressions (Tables 3, 5, 7) use $controls (L.areachance L.p1 L.p2 L.p3 L.approval_cul). Tables 4-5 split PHA into subgroup indicators (extra treatment regressors). The only control-free regressions are appendix Table A.8 cols 4-7 (physician payments, reghdfe total_payment post_PHA, absorb(physician_id time_month), separately per PHA case, i.e. single-date). No data are shipped.
design_notes: Firm-year panel (ms_firm_year.dta) and firm-ICD-year panel (ms_firm_icd_year.dta, market = ICD-10 second-level code) from Biomedtracker matched to Compustat, 2000-2016; physician-month payments panel (ms_physician.dta, Open Payments). Outcomes: ebit_ta, rd_ta, debt_ta, drug acquisitions, late-stage trial initiations, project initiations, suspensions, holds. Figure 2: event study with advisorytm4..advisorytp* leads/lags plus controls.
estimators_reported: single-date DiD per PHA case (Table A.8 physician payments)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: PHA years spread over 2000-2016; not countable without data.
